description: 107 animal classes for Kingdom Ov Animals adventure mode. Uses taxonomic Orders and colloquial groupings for player-friendly selection.
note: Each 'class' represents a thematic animal grouping. Children are representative species/examples for card generation.

classes.description: Pack hunters known for loyalty and teamwork
Swift runners of the open plains
Gentle forest dwellers with prehensile snouts
Agile primates of Africa and Asia
Ocean giants that filter the seas
Gentle sea cows of warm waters
Tiny, fierce hunters with fast metabolisms
Raptors with keen eyesight and talons
Constricting giants of the Old World
Venomous ambush predators with hinged fangs
Arboreal climbers with sticky toe pads

metadata.usageNotes: Each 'class' is a player-selectable starting faction. Children represent potential card variants within that class.
